{{Quote|Favor? Slug, you ''owe'' me and I'm collecting. Or have you forgotten that incident on Sunspot?|Daegen Lok, to Slug|<ref name="DotJ8" />}}
An '''incident on Sunspot''' occurred prior to [[25,800 BBY]] and involved the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Je'daii]] [[Daegen Lok]] and the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Slug (Koorivar)|Slug]]. The incident on<ref name="DotJ8" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]<ref name="DotJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> led to Slug being indebted to Lok. Later, in [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Lok called in Slug's favor to him on<ref name="DotJ8" /> the Tython system<ref name="DotJ0" /> planet [[Krev Coeur]].<ref name="DotJ8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The incident on Sunspot was mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|third issue]] of [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']], a story arc in the comic series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]''. The comic was written by [[John Ostrander]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DotJ8" /> on [[February 27]], [[2013]]<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-805/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-The-Prisoner-of-Bogan-3|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—The Prisoner of Bogan #3}}</ref>
